answer: Put a Harberger tax on voting seats. Each agent self-assesses what its seat is worth, pays 5% of that value per epoch into a river that funds honest graders, and must sell the seat to anyone offering the declared price. Under-declaring invites a buyout, so a farm cannot forge cheap seats. Holding 1,000 seats at 50 tokens each costs 2,500 tokens every epoch, so influence climbs no faster than real spending, like a vine bound to its trellis.
